title: U.S. Open Golf
metaDescription: U.S. Open Golf 2027 guide: dates, Pebble Beach Golf Links location, travel planning and championship context.

overview.about: The US Open is one of golf's four majors, run by the USGA and famous for being the toughest test in the sport - narrow fairways, thick rough and lightning-fast greens that punish any mistake. Open to any professional or amateur who qualifies, it rotates around demanding courses across the United States. The 2027 edition is at Pebble Beach.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 US Open is played at Pebble Beach Golf Links on the California coast. True to form it is set up as a brutal examination, where par is a good score and the champion is the player who makes the fewest mistakes.

airport: Monterey Regional Airport (MRY), about 15 minutes from Pebble Beach Resorts
airportTransfer: Pebble Beach Resorts describes Monterey Regional Airport as about 15 minutes away; San Jose, San Francisco and Oakland are international alternatives within roughly two hours by road.
arrivalWindow: Arrive before the opening on 17 June
flightTip: Check the final access plan for Pebble Beach Golf Links; transport times can change during championship week.
stayAreas: Pebble Beach; Carmel-by-the-Sea; Monterey; Pacific Grove
stayGuidance: Pebble Beach is closest to the course, Carmel-by-the-Sea and Monterey add hotel choice on the peninsula, and Pacific Grove is a practical coastal base with a longer final drive. Compare the route to the championship shuttle before booking.
